description: Current gas/fee tiers and USD costs for one chain. Slow/standard/fast gas tiers and USD cost of a transfer, USDC transfer and swap, for Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana. Updated every 15s. Solana is compute-unit pricing, not gwei-style gas; the other 5 are EVM. Use for one chain's prices; use compare_gas_costs to rank all 6. x402: 402 first, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (MCP: _meta["x402/payment"]) — unpaid/failed calls are never charged. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_gas_price
